standard_prerequisites.use: Smooth morphisms, etale neighbourhoods of the base, and the behaviour of geometric connectedness of fibres under smooth morphisms with a section; the construction is retained.

core_obligations: Localise to obtain smooth affine pieces of the morphism over etale neighbourhoods of the base.
Arrange each piece to have a section and geometrically connected fibres, and verify the resulting family is an etale covering.

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce to smooth affine pieces over etale neighbourhoods of the base.
Arrange a section for each piece.
Arrange geometric connectedness of the fibres and assemble the covering.

difficulty_reason: The lemma produces an etale covering of the source of a smooth morphism such that each member factors through an etale morphism to the base and is itself a smooth morphism of affine schemes with a section and geometrically connected fibres. The proof localises to obtain affine smooth pieces, then reorganises each piece so that the projection to an etale neighbourhood of the base is a smooth affine morphism with a section, and finally arranges geometric connectedness of the fibres. Producing simultaneously the section and the geometric connectedness of the fibres is the load-bearing part. Retained author proof at lines 10965-10994.
